verdict.rationale: Dynadot's API docs say it can programmatically manage DNS among 120+ actions, and the reseller/WHMCS integration lets users adjust DNS settings. However, nothing shows record-level create, update, and delete operations, and the MCP server only claims to review (read) DNS records. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-record create/update/delete endpoints, any ACME/DNS-01 challenge support or guidance, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of DNS record automation.
